title: Prewire and structured wiring

roles.label: 42" structured media enclosure
roles.capability: Central enclosure where every cable home-runs

roles.label: Cat6 data outlet

quantity.verify: count of data outlets, TV locations, access points and cameras

roles.capability: Cat6 home run to the enclosure, terminated on a keystone jack

roles.label: Cat6 cable (per foot)

quantity.verify: about 75 ft of Cat6 per data outlet

roles.capability: Cat6 550 MHz cable for the data runs

roles.label: Coax outlet
roles.capability: RG6 home run for cable, satellite or antenna

roles.label: Speaker prewire

quantity.verify: count of speaker locations (one per pair of terminals)

roles.capability: Speaker wire roughed in for future speakers

labor.basis: Livewire packages since 2025: Cat6 Run 1 hour per drop (30 ft), Cat6 Retro 2 hours (75 ft); enclosure set and home-run termination about 2 hours; coax and speaker drops about 0.75 hours each in new construction

assumptions: New construction or open walls: cables are run before drywall.
One rough-in visit and one trim-out visit.
Quantities marked as minimums are confirmed against the floor plan.
exclusions: Equipment for the outlets (TVs, access points, speakers) unless listed.
Electrical work and permits unless listed.
